svg.title: Text-to-Speech Pipeline
svg.desc: A text_to_speech MCP call creates a queued synthesis job. A separate register_voice job can denoise and publish a reference for a cloned voice. SynthesisService loads the selected voice, generates text chunks with Qwen3-TTS, then assembles and publishes the audio.

g.text: Choose a preset speaker or a registered clone.
Submit an audio path and confirm consent.
Resolve language, format and chunking options.
Pin the cloned voice version or select a preset.
Commit the queued job in PostgreSQL.
Convert to 24 kHz mono WAV with FFmpeg.
Optionally denoise at 48 kHz with DeepFilterNet.
Validate the recording and publish the reference.
Claim the job and dispatch to SynthesisService.
Reference audio in local storage or S3
Reuse the prepared reference across TTS jobs.
Load the pinned clone reference or
Run one chunk at a time.
Upload the file to local storage or S3.
Save the asset and mark the job complete.
Job ID, status and audio file
Get the finished file location and audio duration.
Receive it inline or call get_job(job_id).

svg.text: Reuse staged audio after a failed publish
The worker can retry publication without running synthesis again.
Generate an audio file with a preset speaker or a registered cloned voice.
